name: Circular Carousel
description: Draggable 3D image carousel that arranges photos on a cylinder, orbit, vertical wheel or inward panorama, with drift or step autoplay, momentum, parallax and optional captions.
contents: Ring of image cards built from curved tiles, each with title and subtitle data
Optional caption with animated two-digit counter for the active item
Screen reader live region announcing the active slide
behavior: Intro animation on load (rise, assemble, spin or none) after images preload
Autoplay drifts continuously or steps every few seconds, pausing on mouse hover
Drag with momentum and optional snapping to the nearest card
Pointer parallax tilts the scene and drag stretches it
Wheel scrolling over the carousel rotates it
Keyboard arrows, Home, End and Enter or Space navigate and activate
Clicking a card focuses it and fires onItemClick
Changing items cross-fades old images out when the count is unchanged
Render loop pauses when off screen or tab hidden
Reduced motion disables intro, autoplay, parallax and stretch
editableByProps: Images, alt text, titles and subtitles, any number of items
Layout preset, card size, aspect ratio, gap, curvature, tilt, perspective
Intro style, autoplay mode, speed, interval, direction
Drag, momentum, snapping, hover pause, click focus
Parallax, stretch, depth fade, fade color, inner shade, corner radius
Captions toggle, change and click callbacks, container class and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change preset geometry or add a new layout
Change intro, swap or spring timing
needsCodeEdit.where: INTRO_LENGTH, SWAP_LENGTH, SWAP_SPREAD and SPRING constants
aria-label="Image carousel" on the root element

fixed: Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Sample photos are loaded from images.unsplash.com and forced grayscale
Preloads up to the first 16 images, intro starts after load or a 2.4 second timeout
Wheel events over the carousel are captured with preventDefault, blocking page scroll there
Panorama preset ignores the perspective prop and wheel preset limits the visible window
Injects a style tag with keyframes for caption and image swap animations
Uses Tailwind classes and a 'use client' directive

options.look: Horizontal ring of curved cards seen from the outside with slight tilt
Wider ring of flat cards that always face the viewer, tilted from above
options.useWhen: You want flat uncurved images circling in space

options.look: Vertical wheel rotating on the X axis with fading top and bottom edges
options.useWhen: A vertical scrolling feel in a tall container

options.look: Camera inside the ring looking at curved cards with fading left and right edges
